limits: Runs no test and returns no statistic, by design.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lists names, lengths and GC fractions; a design step, not a measurement.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does a discovery corpus hold, before any test is run on it?

description: The design step's view of a discovery corpus: each record's name, file, length and GC fraction, and how many records each file holds. Runs no test and returns no statistic, so hypotheses proposed from it are proposed before any result is seen (POPPER's metadata-only design step). Use it before run_discovery_programme.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

sequences.description: the corpus: library document or file names, or wired records.

records.description: every record: name, file, length, GC fraction
